featured_reviews.name: Sanjana Suresh
featured_reviews.review_text:
GHAR KA KHANA: FAR FROM THE REALITY!!!
We ordered 3 days of tiffin service by looking at the reviews.
Day 1: Both lunch and dinner had extremely bland tasting sabjiz which we didn’t really like but still didn’t mind. But at night both the packets of rice was uncooked so we thought of immediately taking some action. We contacted the owner and asked for a refund. The Owner is extremely shrewd and said you were already told about no refund policy, if you don’t want the food we wont send it but no refund. We asked her about this policy as it wasn’t informed to us, in reply she says you didn’t ask only so we didn’t say contradicting her own statement. The owner admitted that she had sent Chinese rice instead of normal one by error. We still tried to get the refund since this was our only meal for the day and such uncooked food might harm our system. Then the owner actually started saying you guys are uneducated and want your money {P.S. All this after she admitted that she sent Chinese rice}. I tried to explain her that we genuinely didn’t like the food and we are honest about it so she said I get orders from many celebrities and what not, so we just left the topic and told her to continue for next 2 days.
Day 2: Both meals were extremely decent, delivery was late by 10 pm but still not that bland taste so we actually thought of giving it a chance.
Day 3: Last dinner meal was she msgd at 8.30 pm saying your food hasn’t left the kitchen so ill provide you with refund. {Hmm after all this discussion you actually show us that you have a refund policy and are just trying to fool the customers}
After follow-ups many time she sent us the refund.
So finally, I would suggest everyone to absolutely do not buy any food from this so called tiffin service. Very unprofessional and incorrectly managed. After our experience, we feel bad about the poor customers who have ordered from here based on those baseless reviews. If you still want to order, only pay for one meal and see you might instantly regret your decision.
SAVE MONEY AND DON’T WASTE IT ON SUCH STUPID SO CALLED TIFFIN SERVICE. Find better options.

featured_reviews.name: Shubham Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text: The food quality was ok. But after some time they started giving same vegetables. The worst experience is that they will forget your tiffin and not even send it after you remind them. On the last they, the lady did not sent the tiffin and when I tried to call her, she just kept her phone on switchoff. They will ask you for advance payment and then do this things. Dont fall in the trap. If your are choosing this keep payment terms as postpaid.

He serves to students, even then, he will take so much more holidays than what was said by him when asked. He said 2 per month, which would be sundays. But since past few months, he's been taking as many as 3 one week accounting up to 5-6 per month.

Very pathetic service. Don't recommend it to anyone. It's not a “tiffin” service at all.

Just made for namesake so as to loot the poor students.

featured_reviews.name: Amanda Sodhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
UPDATE - after inspecting the rest of the packet, turns out THREE things sharp bones not just 1!!!

I was holding back from leaving a public review for a while but this is the last straw. Despite giving clear instructions for only boneless shredded chicken for my pug, there were several documented instances where the staff was not briefed and they sent huge chunks he could not eat. They started improving but today they sent a packet with a thin sharp bone that could have proven fatal for my dog had I not seen it and removed it. When I informed them of this their response was just a facepalm emoji. Ridiculous. Please triple check food you order from here to avoid any choking hazard for your puppy.

The quality and quantity is great. 10/10 recommend.
